data.title: 五更琉璃 · 夜间泳池黑猫系带比基尼的浮板羞涩
data.description: 夏夜亮起水下彩灯的静谧泳池，琉璃身着带有可爱猫耳发箍与小猫爪装饰的黑色系带比基尼，抱紧浮板趴在水面，害羞得耳尖发红。
data.location: 点缀水底灯光的夜间泳池
data.action: 趴在粉色浮板上，双腿在清凉池水中轻轻扑腾，猫耳头箍微颤，羞涩地偏过头不肯直视
data.lighting: 水下碧蓝荧光灯自下而上照射，泛起粼粼水纹倒影
data.camera: 水面齐平微俯机位，展现娇小的少女身姿与透明水感
data.promptProse: Ruri Gokou, known as Kuroneko, floats nervously on a pastel pink kickboard in a private swimming pool illuminated by electric blue underwater lights. She is dressed in a playful black ruffled bikini complete with a plush cat-ear headband and subtle paw motifs. Flustered to the tips of her ears, she turns her head aside with an intense crimson blush, trying to maintain her haughty composure amidst the ripples.
data.animaCaption: Clutching a floating board in the illuminated night pool, Kuroneko looks away with flushed cheeks and cat-ear headband.
